case_name: Kamlesh Kumar And Others v. State Of U.P. & Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Kamlesh Kumar And Others (husband, wife, etc.)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of U.P. & Others (wife, husband, etc.)

facts_of_case: Complaint Case No. 1660 of 2010 under Section 12 of the Domestic Violence and Women's Protection Act, 2005; opposite party no. 2 initiated proceedings after divorce petition was allowed; applicants filed application to quash proceedings

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside a decree of divorce to prove that the decree was obtained by fraud, coercion, or undue influence.
legal_principles.held: It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicants that the opposite party no. 2 after being selected in B.T.C., went back to Haridwar and joined her assignment.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot initiate multiple proceedings against the same person for the same alleged wrong, and then claim that each proceeding is independent of the others.
legal_principles.held: It is next contended that the opposite party no. 2 as a counter blast, initiated proceedings under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station - Govind Nagar, District - Kanpur Nagar, and the arrest of the applicants was stayed by this Court, and thereafter, in order to harass the applicants, the present proceedings under Section 12 of the Domestic Violence Act has been initiated by the opposite party no. 2.

outcome.final_order: Issue notice to opposite party no. 2, returnable within four weeks; steps be taken within a week; no coercive steps shall be taken against the applicants till next date of listing

use_for_drafting: defending against dowry prohibition act charges
